edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender to _transfer from transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender and allowance owner in transferFrom.
transfer calls the private _transfer routine.
transferFrom calls the private _transfer routine.
_transfer calls collectFee to compute fee-adjusted amounts.
_transfer calls _getReflectionRate to obtain current rate.
_getReflectionRate returns the rate consumed by _transfer.
_taxFee is multiplied and divided inside collectFee affecting transfer amounts.
_burnFee is used in subtractive burn arithmetic inside collectFee.
charityAddress receives credited charity reflection balance in collectFee.
_tokenTotal is compared and subtracted in burn logic in collectFee.
_reflectionTotal is reduced by tax fee arithmetic in collectFee.
_taxFeeTotal is accumulated via add in collectFee.
_charityFeeTotal is accumulated via add in collectFee.
_burnFeeTotal is accumulated via add in collectFee.
_reflectionBalance entries are subtracted and added in _transfer.
_tokenBalance entries are subtracted and added in _transfer for excluded accounts.
isExcludedFromFee lookups determine whether collectFee is invoked.
_isExcluded is read and set inside excludeAccount.
_isExcluded is read and cleared inside includeAccount.
onlyOwner modifier checks _owner before excludeAccount executes.
onlyOwner modifier checks _owner before includeAccount executes.
onlyOwner modifier checks _owner before setTaxFee executes.
onlyOwner modifier checks _owner before renounceOwnership executes.
onlyOwner modifier checks _owner before transferOwnership executes.
collectFee performs repeated subtraction and accumulation arithmetic on supplies and fees.
_transfer performs subtraction/addition arithmetic on reflection balances.
amount parameter flows into _transfer and drives fee computations.
recipient parameter flows into _transfer to credit balances.
sender parameter flows into _transfer as the debited account.
account parameter is used in collectFee for fee events and debits.
rate local variable carried from _transfer and used in collectFee math.
burnFee local computed from _burnFee drives subtraction arithmetic.
charityFee local computed from _charityFee drives subtraction arithmetic.
taxFee local computed from _taxFee drives subtraction arithmetic.
taxFeeAfter50millionSupply local drives subtraction arithmetic.
lastBurnAmount local drives subtraction arithmetic on _tokenTotal.
transferAmount local accumulates all fee subtractions.
receive() entrypoint can be re-entered through the low-level value call transferring control to a recipient.
